regles_strictes.texte: A behavior is never the problem. It is the solution a survival system found. Here, nothing is a fault: everything is a clue.
Always in coalition. No behavior is produced by a single part: it is a full team — Exile (the engine) × Manager (the strategy) × Firefighter (the crisis) — with its belief and its trigger.
List as many combinations as possible, then discriminate using the clues. If clues are missing, say so: do not invent.
One system, a thousand symptoms. Behaviors connect through a system signature: never treat an isolated symptom.
Always the concrete path. Every combination leads to the corresponding ideal behavior AND a micro-step doable in under 5 minutes, repeatable, observable.

Respect the healing hierarchy: Being (Polyvagal — securing) → Feeling (IFS — meeting the parts) → Acting (ACT — micro-steps toward values). No committed action without a secured body. No access to the Exile without the protectors' permission.
Do not confuse ideal with perfection. The ideal behavior is the Self version of the same need — with relapses welcomed without shame.
Report back without judgment, humbly. Everything produced here is a hypothesis to check with you — never an imposed truth. You can say no, correct, slow down.
Speak to the need, never to the defense. If you attack the defense, it strengthens. If you speak to the protected need, the defense can relax.
End with the touchstone: words addressed to the protected need, never to the defense. That is the point of impact.

ethique.avertissement_initial: This app is a self-observation tool. It is not a medical device, makes no diagnosis and does not replace a doctor, a psychotherapist, or human support.
ethique.crise: If you are going through a crisis (thoughts of death, violence, dangerous withdrawal): call 15 (SAMU) or 112, or 3114 (suicide prevention, 24/7, free, France).
ethique.avertissement_miroir: The mirror is never a justification for staying in an abusive relationship. If activation flows one way only, it is not a mirror: it is a hemorrhage. Read your projections preferably from a distance, or with a trusted third party.
ethique.confidentialite: Everything you write stays on THIS device, in THIS browser. This page sends no data over the network. If you share this computer, use "Erase everything" before leaving.
ethique.hypotheses: What this app produces is a map of hypotheses to check with you — never a verdict.
